items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: Primitives for composing activity and timeline feeds.

items.name: alerts
items.title: Alerts
items.description: Primitives for alerts: critical, warning, info and resolved severities, each with an icon and label, plus relative time formatting.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.description: An animated number component.

items.name: animated-wave
items.title: Animated Wave
items.description: An animated wave component.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Chart components.

items.name: billing
items.title: Billing
items.description: Primitives for subscription billing: currency formatting, MRR movement from starting to ending MRR, net revenue retention, a waterfall of the movement and an invoice status badge.

items.name: block-state
items.title: Block State
items.description: Primitives for loading, refreshing, empty and error states: a skeleton, a dimmed frame that keeps its layout while it refreshes, a message with an action, and a data-loading hook.

items.name: breakdown
items.title: Breakdown
items.description: Primitives for part-to-whole breakdowns: a segmented 100% bar, legend keys and share formatting.

items.name: chart-panel
items.title: Chart Panel
items.description: Primitives for full-size chart panels: tooltip, legend, axis defaults and an accessible data table.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: Primitives for checklists and steppers: done, in progress, to do and skipped states, each with a marker shape and label, progress maths that leaves skipped steps out, and a styled checkbox.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Primitives for dashboard tables: sortable headers, inline bars, pagination and a stacked layout for narrow cards.

items.name: comparison
items.title: Comparison
items.description: Primitives for comparisons: deltas, a two-proportion test with a 95% interval, diverging bars, dumbbells and an interval bar.

items.name: dashboard-header
items.title: Dashboard Header
items.description: Primitives for dashboard headers: a date range preset menu, a compare switch, filter menus, filter chips and an export menu.

items.name: deployments
items.title: Deployments
items.description: Primitives for deployments: ready, failed, running, queued and rolled back statuses each with an icon and label, duration and short commit formatting, DORA bands for deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and time to restore, a DORA badge and a run history strip.

items.name: distribution
items.title: Distribution
items.description: Primitives for distributions: quantiles from raw values or from binned counts, binning, a five-number summary, the share above a limit, round ticks, a histogram with labelled percentile and threshold lines and an outline for an earlier period, a box plot, an axis and legend keys.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: Primitives for customer feedback: a rating summary with the average and share of each rating, CSAT as the share of 4 and 5 ratings, net sentiment, stars filled to a fractional rating, and a stacked or diverging sentiment bar with legend keys.

items.name: flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: Primitives for flows: a Sankey layout that places nodes in columns and links as bands, keeping each flow's colour downstream and drawing drop-offs muted, a Sankey chart with hover highlighting and a readout, and path steps as chips.

items.name: forecast
items.title: Forecast
items.description: Primitives for forecasts: a straight-line fit with a prediction interval that widens with the horizon, run-rate projection, date-to-target solving, a striped projection bar, legend keys, a tooltip and a status badge.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: Primitives for conversion funnels: step conversion maths and horizontal or vertical stage bars.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: Primitives for gauges and scores: a semicircle or three-quarter arc gauge built as a meter, with labelled bands, a target tick and an animated fill, plus band, weighted score and NPS helpers.

items.name: geo
items.title: Geo
items.description: Primitives for location metrics: a US state tile map, a dotted world map from an embedded land mask with markers sized by value, country flags and share bars.

items.name: goals
items.title: Goals
items.description: Primitives for goals and targets: pace against a straight line to the target, a progress bar with an expected-by-now marker, and a pace badge.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Primitives for heatmaps: a single-hue colour scale, a keyboard-readable grid with a readout line, a legend and an accessible data table.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: An icon component.

items.name: insights
items.title: Insights
items.description: Primitives for insights: positive, negative, neutral and anomaly kinds, each with an icon and label, sentences with highlighted metrics, and a "why" line of drivers.

items.name: inventory
items.title: Inventory
items.description: Primitives for inventory: out of stock, low, in stock and overstock from on-hand stock and the reorder point, each with an icon and label, days of cover, a reorder quantity for the lead time plus a target, and a stock bar with a reorder point tick.

items.name: kpi
items.title: KPI
items.description: A flexible KPI card with trend indicators, sparklines, and progress tracking.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: Primitives for composing ranked lists and leaderboards.

items.name: metric-list
items.title: Metric List
items.description: Primitives for compact lists of metrics: a row with value, direction-aware change and sparkline, a bar against a target with its status, and value formatting helpers.

items.name: pipeline
items.title: Pipeline
items.description: Primitives for pipelines of work in flight: stage summaries with count, value and weighted value, days in stage with a stuck state, a stage header, an item card and currency and age formatting.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: A progress bar component.

items.name: realtime
items.title: Realtime
items.description: Primitives for live data: an interval hook, a seeded random generator for demo streams, a rolling window, a pulsing live badge that stays still for reduced motion, a number that counts to each new value, rolling bars and a short time-ago format.

items.name: retention
items.title: Retention
items.description: Primitives for retention: rates per cohort, a size-weighted average curve, where the curve levels off, the growth accounting quick ratio, a shaded cohort table, a bar with an earlier-value tick and a change in percentage points.

items.name: ring
items.title: Ring
items.description: A ring component.

items.name: scatter
items.title: Scatter
items.description: Primitives for scatter plots and matrices: a least-squares line with the correlation coefficient described in words, a median, categorical colours in a fixed order, point tooltip content, and risk levels from likelihood and impact with a labelled swatch.

items.name: schedule
items.title: Schedule
items.description: Primitives for schedules: date helpers that take a fixed now and a time zone, an event row, urgency badges and a keyboard-navigable month calendar.

items.name: security
items.title: Security
items.description: Primitives for security: info, warning and critical audit severities and passing, attention and failing check results, each with an icon and label, a desktop or phone device icon, a weighted security score and a time-since format.

items.name: spend
items.title: Spend
items.description: Primitives for spend and budgets: pace against an even spend of the budget with a projected total and a status, runway at the current net burn, a budget bar with overspend and a striped projection, a status badge with an icon and label, and legend keys.

items.name: stat-group
items.title: Stat Group
items.description: Primitives for a row of related stats: a divided grid, labels, values, change vs the previous period and sparklines.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: Primitives for service status: status levels with icons and labels, badges, indicators and a 90-day uptime bar.

items.name: team
items.title: Team
items.description: Primitives for people: avatars with initials and a colour picked from the name, presence with a dot and a label, and an avatar stack with a "+N" overflow.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Primitives for timelines: a UTC date scale, week, month and quarter ticks, days between dates, done, in progress, planned and at risk statuses each with an icon and label, an axis, grid lines, a today line and a Gantt-style timeline with grouped rows, progress fills and a readout.

items.name: trend
items.title: Trend
items.description: A trend indicator component.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage Meter
items.description: A usage meter component.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Store dashboard
items.description: A store dashboard: header filters scope stats, revenue, channels, products and a checkout funnel.

items.name: dashboard-02
items.title: SaaS dashboard
items.description: A SaaS dashboard: metric tabs, an activity heatmap, accounts by region and service status, filtered by plan.

items.name: use-animated-number
items.title: Use Animated Number
items.description: A hook for animating a number.

items.name: use-in-view
items.title: Use In View
items.description: A hook that tracks whether an element is visible in the viewport using IntersectionObserver.
